specification_source: inputs/SRS2_1.md (OR-SRS-SDS-2026-V2.1: Full Community, Dual-Screen Architecture & Club Governance)

stack.frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons)
stack.design_system: Soft-Clay SaaS Architecture + 10 Functional Pairs (20 Dedicated Core Screens) + 6 Dedicated Portals
stack.test_runner: Jest + Headless Chrome CDP Real-DOM E2E

acceptance_criteria.story: Valid Standard Run Activity (US-ENG-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: A running activity with distance 5.2 km, moving time 1716 seconds (pace 5:30 min/km), elevation gain 40 m within race window
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called with default rules
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is valid (isValid=true) with finalDistanceKm=5.2 and bonusDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Distance Below Minimum Threshold (US-ENG-02)
acceptance_criteria.given: A running activity with distance 2.8 km (below minDistanceKm=3.0 km)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is rejected with rejectCode='BELOW_MIN_DISTANCE' and finalDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Pace Exceeding Maximum Limit with Valid Trail Elevation Gain (US-ENG-03)
acceptance_criteria.given: A trail run with distance 6.0 km, moving time 4380 seconds (pace 12:10 min/km), and elevation gain 260 m (>= trailGainMinM 100 m)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called with gainUnitM=100 and distUnitKm=1.0
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is accepted as Trail Run with bonus = floor(260/100)*1.0 = 2.0 km and finalDistanceKm=8.0

acceptance_criteria.story: Pace Exceeding Maximum Limit without Sufficient Gain (US-ENG-04)
acceptance_criteria.given: A run with distance 4.0 km, moving time 2640 seconds (pace 11:00 min/km), and elevation gain 60 m (< 100 m)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is rejected with rejectCode='PACE_TOO_SLOW_NO_GAIN' and finalDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Pace Too Fast / Fraud Suspected (US-ENG-05)
acceptance_criteria.given: A run with moving time 480 seconds for 5.0 km (pace 1:36 min/km, faster than paceMin 4:00 and system floor 2:45 min/km)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is flagged with PACE_IMPLAUSIBLE and rejected

acceptance_criteria.story: Daily Activity Limit Enforcement (US-ENG-06)
acceptance_criteria.when: A 3rd activity on the same date is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.then: The 3rd activity is rejected with rejectCode='DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED' and finalDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Overlapping Activities Detection (US-ENG-07)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() checks overlapping time ranges
acceptance_criteria.then: The activity is rejected with rejectCode='DUPLICATE_OVERLAP' and finalDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Weekly Cycle Distance Target and Penalty Calculation with Proration (US-PEN-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: calculateWeeklyPenalty() is executed with partialWeekPolicy='prorate'
acceptance_criteria.then: Penalty of 50,000 VND is assessed and appended to participant ledger; warning state triggers within 48h window

acceptance_criteria.story: Team Score Computation with Distance Ratio and Capped Diligent Days (US-SCR-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: calculateTeamScore() runs with 50/50 weights (Distance / Diligence)
acceptance_criteria.then: Rank 1 team scores highest (e.g. 18.43 pts) and pays 100k; all remaining tied teams receive Rank 2 and pay 200k

acceptance_criteria.story: Tiered Contribution and Ledger Balance Calculation (US-FIN-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: calculateParticipantLedger() is computed including accumulated weekly penalties
acceptance_criteria.then: Final individual balance equals (Tier Contribution + Sum(Penalties) - Waivers) with dynamic VietQR generation (ref <= 25 chars)

acceptance_criteria.story: Fast Acknowledgment and Event Queuing (US-WH-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: POST /api/webhooks/strava is received
acceptance_criteria.then: Server acknowledges with HTTP 200 within 200ms, logs raw sync event, and enqueues activity for async processing

acceptance_criteria.story: Manual Adjustment on Approved Appeal (US-APP-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: reviewAppeal() approves the appeal
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity log transitions to APPROVED, final credited distance is updated, and team score is recomputed

acceptance_criteria.story: Audit Trail Logging for Administrative Actions (US-AUD-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: Admin performs manual actions (approves appeal, marks payment, grants penalty waiver)
acceptance_criteria.when: The action is persisted
acceptance_criteria.then: An immutable audit log entry is written with actor_id, timestamp, entity_id, and mutation payload

acceptance_criteria.story: Admin can review and approve runner appeals
acceptance_criteria.when: Admin approves an appeal with credited KM
acceptance_criteria.then: Appeal status is APPROVED and audit log records the decision

acceptance_criteria.story: Admin can reconcile and mark financial payments as settled
acceptance_criteria.when: Admin marks a ledger entry as paid
acceptance_criteria.then: Ledger status transitions to PAID and outstanding debt becomes zero

acceptance_criteria.story: Admin can grant penalty waivers with valid reason
acceptance_criteria.when: Admin grants a waiver with reason
acceptance_criteria.then: Waiver record is created and deducted from net payable debt

acceptance_criteria.story: Admin can manage race lifecycle states and view system metrics
acceptance_criteria.when: Admin inspects system status or transitions lifecycle state
acceptance_criteria.then: Lifecycle state updates cleanly and metrics report active runner and activity counts

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner can view Strava connection status and trigger quick sync
acceptance_criteria.given: Connected runner on Dashboard [1.0]
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner requests sync status or triggers manual sync
acceptance_criteria.then: Returns last synced timestamp, webhook connectivity, and updates runner progress

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner can inspect weekly progress, prorate target, and 6h grace info
acceptance_criteria.given: A runner with mid-week join or standard 20.0 km cycle
acceptance_criteria.when: Viewing weekly progress widget
acceptance_criteria.then: Displays completed km, prorated target, and grace hours tooltip

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner receives prominent warning banner when cycle ends within 48h and target unfulfilled
acceptance_criteria.given: Time remaining in week < 48h and runner completed < 70% of target
acceptance_criteria.when: Dashboard loads
acceptance_criteria.then: Warning banner renders with potential penalty amount and remaining km required

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner can view carousel of active races with team standing
acceptance_criteria.given: Runner enrolled in multiple races
acceptance_criteria.when: Navigating race carousel
acceptance_criteria.then: Renders current team rank, individual contribution, and top reward badge

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner can join new race via invite code or QR scan
acceptance_criteria.given: Valid race invite code or QR payload
acceptance_criteria.when: Submitting join race action
acceptance_criteria.then: Enrolls runner into race and appends new race card to active carousel

acceptance_criteria.story: Race Arena displays hero banner, countdown clock, and key race metrics
acceptance_criteria.given: Race Arena view [2.0]
acceptance_criteria.when: Loading active race
acceptance_criteria.then: Renders days remaining, total registered athletes, and aggregate km

acceptance_criteria.story: Arena renders team leaderboard with Top 1 vs Tied Rank 2 fund dues
acceptance_criteria.given: Active teams in race arena
acceptance_criteria.when: Viewing team standings
acceptance_criteria.then: Rank 1 displays 100k fund due; tied rank 2 teams display 200k fund due with tie-break rules

acceptance_criteria.story: Arena renders individual leaderboard with Top 1 prize badge and sticky self row
acceptance_criteria.given: Individual runners ranked by verified km
acceptance_criteria.when: Switching to individual view
acceptance_criteria.then: Top 1 runner displays prize badge (Áo SARC) and sticky bottom bar shows current user rank and gap

acceptance_criteria.story: Arena provides dedicated My Team space with roster and cheer board
acceptance_criteria.given: Enrolled athlete in a race team
acceptance_criteria.when: Accessing My Team tab
acceptance_criteria.then: Renders teammate roster, captain info, and interactive team cheer messages

acceptance_criteria.story: Arena provides SSE live stream event stream for real-time rank updates
acceptance_criteria.given: Live race event stream endpoint
acceptance_criteria.when: SSE connection is open
acceptance_criteria.then: Broadcasts activity notifications and real-time leaderboard rank adjustments

acceptance_criteria.story: Club Hub renders club profile, leadership roster, and official bulletin
acceptance_criteria.when: Loading club portal
acceptance_criteria.then: Displays chairman, technical lead, treasurer, and pinned feed announcements

acceptance_criteria.story: Club Hub onboarding detects Zalo/Facebook in-app browser and requires dual consents
acceptance_criteria.when: Loading invite onboarding
acceptance_criteria.then: Shows detour banner with copyable short code and enforces mandatory dual consents

acceptance_criteria.story: Full Activity Appeals Workflow & Verification
acceptance_criteria.given: Rejected activity with pace < 2:45 min/km or missing gain
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner submits appeal drawer with evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity status becomes PENDING_APPEAL and admin can grant credited KM

acceptance_criteria.story: Race Setup & 7-Step Rule Configurator Execution
acceptance_criteria.given: Race Operations [7.1] setup screen
acceptance_criteria.when: Admin creates or updates a race using the 7-step wizard (pace floor 2:45 min/km, target 20km)
acceptance_criteria.then: New race is saved, published, and selectable in arena and dashboard

acceptance_criteria.story: All sub-functions render as dedicated screens with soft-clay styling
acceptance_criteria.when: User navigates to any sub-function
acceptance_criteria.then: View switches to that isolated screen with breadcrumb banner and sub-nav pills switcher

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner can self-service disconnect Strava while preserving historic race activities
acceptance_criteria.given: Connected runner with active Strava token and historic evaluated runs
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner calls DELETE /api/v1/me/strava
acceptance_criteria.then: Strava status transitions to REVOKED, new sync is blocked, all historic runs remain credited

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner can inspect raw webhook ingestion and sync logs
acceptance_criteria.given: Incoming Strava webhook activities and historical pulls
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner requests GET /api/v1/me/strava/sync-logs
acceptance_criteria.then: System returns list of sync logs with http status, processing verdict, and raw payload details

acceptance_criteria.story: Race registration enforces 3 scopes (internal, community, designated) and max participants
acceptance_criteria.given: Races with different scopes and max_participants limits
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner registers for a race
acceptance_criteria.then: Internal race rejects non-club members, designated race checks whitelist, and registration auto-locks when capacity reached

acceptance_criteria.story: Race director can upload and manage athlete whitelist for designated races
acceptance_criteria.given: A designated race with scope = designated
acceptance_criteria.when: Admin calls POST /api/v1/races/:slug/whitelist with list of emails
acceptance_criteria.then: Whitelist entries are saved, and only listed emails can successfully join

acceptance_criteria.story: Team Captain can customize team name, avatar, and slogan with live leaderboard reflection
acceptance_criteria.given: Assigned Team Leader in a race team
acceptance_criteria.when: Leader calls PATCH /api/v1/teams/:id with new name, avatar_url, and slogan
acceptance_criteria.then: Team identity is updated and new name and avatar immediately reflect on the live arena leaderboard

acceptance_criteria.story: Athletes can send friend requests, accept, and manage 2-way friendship network
acceptance_criteria.given: Two runners on the platform
acceptance_criteria.when: User A sends request to User B and User B accepts
acceptance_criteria.then: Friendship status becomes accepted and both appear in each other's friends directory

acceptance_criteria.story: Community feed with Friends filter, Kudos engagement, and comments
acceptance_criteria.given: Published community activities
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner gives Kudos and adds comments
acceptance_criteria.then: Kudos count increments, comment is attached, and feed filters correctly between All and Friends

acceptance_criteria.story: Multi-Criteria Rule Engine supports customizable weights for distance, active days, gain, and pace
acceptance_criteria.given: A race configured with multi_criteria_weighted scoring strategy
acceptance_criteria.when: Engine computes team standings
acceptance_criteria.then: Normalized composite scores are calculated according to configured criteria weights sum = 100%

acceptance_criteria.story: Real-time Chat with AI PacerBot and 3-Tier Banter Roast Engine
acceptance_criteria.given: Active chat channels (club, team, direct) and configured Banter engine level
acceptance_criteria.when: Runners chat or milestone triggers occur (pace near limit, rank change, <24h warning)
acceptance_criteria.then: PacerBot answers rule queries and Banter Bot delivers humorous motivation according to selected level

acceptance_criteria.story: Club Governance ERP for Disciplinary Warnings, Offline Events RSVP, and Polls
acceptance_criteria.given: Club admin managing club portal
acceptance_criteria.when: Admin issues disciplinary warning, posts offline group run with RSVP, or creates member poll
acceptance_criteria.then: Members receive alerts, RSVP responses update live, and poll votes are tallied in real time

acceptance_criteria.story: Mantis Material UI Theme Layout & Dual-Theme Switcher (US-THM-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: OpenRace SaaS running with default sporty orange theme
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner or Admin switches theme to 'mantis'
acceptance_criteria.then: Interface activates Mantis Material UI theme: Mantis top bar with Ctrl+K search, categorized drawer sidebar, blue gradient welcome hero, 4 sparkline metric cards, spline area chart, persists in localStorage, and allows switching back to classic anytime

acceptance_criteria.story: Digital Finisher Certificate & QR Verification (US-REC-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: An athlete completed race milestones or podium team finish
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner opens their Certificate of Completion
acceptance_criteria.then: System renders authentic Certificate modal with dynamic athlete name, race title, accredited distance, rank badge, golden medal seal, verification QR code, and export options

acceptance_criteria.story: Interactive Trail Elevation Gain Profile & Anti-Cheat GPS Audit (US-ACT-05)
acceptance_criteria.given: A running or trail activity with elevation gain and track data
acceptance_criteria.when: Auditor or Runner clicks to inspect elevation audit profile
acceptance_criteria.then: System opens Elevation Profile Drawer displaying interactive topography elevation curve, trail bonus calculation steps (+2.0km), cadence verification (no vehicle fraud), and pace consistency

acceptance_criteria.story: Auto-Trim Vehicle Tail on Forgot-to-Stop Running Watch (US-ACT-06)
acceptance_criteria.given: A running activity where the runner completed a valid run (e.g. 10.0km at pace 5:30) but forgot to stop watch and drove 1.5km on motorbike (pace < 2:45 min/km, speed > 30 km/h, cadence < 110 spm)
acceptance_criteria.when: detectAndTrimVehicleTail() or POST /api/activities/:id/auto-trim is executed
acceptance_criteria.then: System detects vehicle tail segment, slices off fraudulent 1.5km, preserves genuine 10.0km run, sets autoTrimmed=true with reason 'AUTO_TRIMMED_VEHICLE_TAIL', and recalculates valid credited distance

acceptance_criteria.story: Garmin Connect & Coros API Direct Sync Ecosystem (US-DEV-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: Athletes who prefer connecting wearable devices directly without Strava intermediary
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner connects Garmin Connect or Coros via GET /api/me/connected-devices and POST /api/me/devices/connect
acceptance_criteria.then: System activates direct wearable ingestion, tracks connection status and last sync time per provider, and receives direct webhook activities

acceptance_criteria.story: Indoor Treadmill Run Validation with Continuous Heart Rate & Cadence (US-ACT-07)
acceptance_criteria.given: An indoor treadmill run without outdoor GPS tracklog
acceptance_criteria.when: Activity is submitted with sportType='TreadmillRun', avgHeartRate >= 120 bpm, and avgCadence >= 150 spm
acceptance_criteria.then: System validates cardiovascular exertion and leg turnover, certifies treadmill run as VALID, and credits distance to weekly target and team scores

acceptance_criteria.story: Standardization of 4 User Portal Groups with 19 Clean Menu Items (US-NAV-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: The OpenRace SaaS navigation ecosystem with diverse user roles (Runner, Club Captain, Platform Admin)
acceptance_criteria.when: Navigation schema is retrieved via GET /api/me/navigation-context or rendered in UI
acceptance_criteria.then: System organizes menus into 4 distinct portal groups: I. Runner Portal (5 items: Dashboard, Activities & Logs, Arena Leaderboard, Devices & Sync, My Finance & GDPR); II. Club & Team Space (5 items: Club Overview, My Teams, Social & Kudos, AI PacerBot, ERP & Polls); III. Club Admin & Captain Portal (5 items: Member Management, Race Operations & Wizard, Batch Activity Review, Finance & VietQR Ledger, Broadcast & Closing); IV. Super Admin / Platform (4 items: System Monitoring, Tenant Management, IAM & RBAC, Global Configurations)

acceptance_criteria.story: Top Header Context Switcher with Instant Role View Switching (US-NAV-02)
acceptance_criteria.given: A logged-in user with multiple authorized roles (Runner, Club Captain, Platform Admin)
acceptance_criteria.when: User interacts with the Top Header Role Dropdown Selector to switch views
acceptance_criteria.then: System updates active portal context, persists selection in localStorage (openrace_active_role), emits visual role badge indicator, and notifies sidebar to adjust visibility

acceptance_criteria.story: Dynamic Sidebar Filtering based on Active User Portal Role (US-NAV-03)
acceptance_criteria.given: User selecting a specific role perspective (Runner, Club Space, Club Admin, Super Admin, or All Portals)
acceptance_criteria.when: filterDynamicSidebar(role) is triggered or initial page loads with active role
acceptance_criteria.then: Sidebar displays only the relevant menu group(s) matching the active role (e.g. runner hides admin groups; captain shows Club Admin; admin shows Super Admin; all displays all 4 groups) with zero visual clutter

acceptance_criteria.story: Navigation Redirection and Functional Parity across Sport Cam and Mantis Themes (US-NAV-04)
acceptance_criteria.given: User navigating through any of the 19 menu items across both Sport Cam and Mantis Material UI themes
acceptance_criteria.when: A menu item is clicked or programmatic tab routing is called
acceptance_criteria.then: System activates the corresponding tab-content, highlights active menu items, preserves breadcrumbs, and updates mobile bottom bar or rail indicators seamlessly

acceptance_criteria.story: Backend User Navigation Context and Role Entitlements API (US-NAV-05)
acceptance_criteria.given: Authenticated athlete user requesting personalized navigation capabilities
acceptance_criteria.when: GET /api/me/navigation-context and POST /api/me/active-role are invoked
acceptance_criteria.then: System validates user permissions, returns available portal roles, current active role, and hierarchical menu permissions, and updates active role preference successfully

acceptance_criteria.story: Global Race Selector Bar & Dynamic State Re-fetch (US-RACE-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: A multi-race OpenRace platform hosting multiple tournaments (Mùa 10 - SARC Summer Race, Mùa 9 - Run to Techcombank, Giải Nội Bộ Quý 3)
acceptance_criteria.when: Athlete or Club Admin changes active tournament via Global Race Selector Bar or GET /api/races/selector
acceptance_criteria.then: System immediately re-fetches race overview via GET /api/races/:id/dashboard without full page refresh, updating all 4 dashboard zones dynamically for that specific race

acceptance_criteria.story: Zone 1 - Race KPI Cards & Progress Tracking (US-RACE-02)
acceptance_criteria.given: Selected race dashboard data
acceptance_criteria.when: KPI metrics are rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: Displays total participants by club/team, total accumulated distance with goal comparison (e.g. 15,420 / 20,000 KM), average completion rate percentage, and transparent prize pool / incurred penalty ledger

acceptance_criteria.story: Zone 2 - Daily Distance Analytics Bar Chart & Activity Type Distribution (US-RACE-03)
acceptance_criteria.given: Race activities aggregated over timeline
acceptance_criteria.when: Analytics section is retrieved or rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: System presents daily distance breakdown highlighting weekend Long Run peaks, and activity type distribution (Road %, Trail %, Treadmill %) for official referee audit

acceptance_criteria.story: Zone 3 - Live Race Leaderboards & Zone 4 - Referee Governance Queues (US-RACE-04)
acceptance_criteria.given: Active race standings and verification activities
acceptance_criteria.when: Leaderboard and Governance queues are loaded
acceptance_criteria.then: Presents Top 5 internal racing teams with Gold/Silver/Bronze medals and cumulative mileage, Top 10 individual breakout runners, and summary of suspicious activities flagged for referee audit

acceptance_criteria.story: Optimal UX Workflow: Ctrl+Shift+R Shortcut, Live SSE Ticker, 1-Touch Export (US-RACE-05)
acceptance_criteria.given: Interactive race dashboard environment
acceptance_criteria.when: User triggers Ctrl+Shift+R keyboard shortcut, monitors SSE ticker, or clicks 1-touch export button
acceptance_criteria.then: Quick race search modal opens instantly, SSE ticker ticks live distance progression, and GET /api/races/:id/export delivers comprehensive finisher and audit reports

acceptance_criteria.story: Concise SaaS Sidebar Navigation Without Dynamic Status Badges (US-NAV-V3-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: OpenRace SaaS sidebar navigation in Runner, Club Space, Club Admin, and Super Admin portals
acceptance_criteria.when: User views navigation items
acceptance_criteria.then: Sidebar displays concise standard SaaS titles (Tổng Quan, Nhật Ký & Bài Chạy, Bảng Xếp Hạng, Kết Nối Thiết Bị, Quỹ & Sổ Nợ, Câu Lạc Bộ, Đội Của Tôi, Bảng Tin & Kudos, Trợ Lý AI, Hoạt Động & Biểu Quyết, Thành Viên, Thiết Lập Giải, Kiểm Duyệt Bài, Tài Chính & Quỹ, Truyền Thông & Chốt Tuần, Giám Sát Hệ Thống, Quản Lý Tenant, Phân Quyền (RBAC), Tham Số Hệ Thống) without distracting dynamic status badges

acceptance_criteria.story: Header Role Context Switcher Multi-Persona Switching (US-NAV-V3-02)
acceptance_criteria.given: User with multiple platform personas (Athlete, Captain, Admin)
acceptance_criteria.when: User selects a persona from the header context switcher dropdown
acceptance_criteria.then: Sidebar immediately filters to that specific portal's navigation items with clear visual indicator and without page refresh

acceptance_criteria.story: Mobile Sticky Bottom Action Bar with 1-Touch Thumb Access (US-MOB-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: Mobile or compact viewport view of OpenRace platform
acceptance_criteria.when: Bottom action bar is rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: Presents thumb-friendly 1-touch action triggers for Đồng bộ Strava, Nộp bài, Sổ nợ QR, and PacerBot AI

acceptance_criteria.story: Optimistic UI for Activity Submission and Strava Queue Sync (US-OPT-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: Athlete submitting a new running activity or triggering Strava sync
acceptance_criteria.when: Submission form is executed
acceptance_criteria.then: UI instantly reflects the progress increment and success toast before network completion, then confirms upon server settlement

acceptance_criteria.story: Server-Sent Events Realtime Broadcast for Live Leaderboards and Ticker (US-SSE-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: Active client browser on Race Leaderboard or Tournament Overview
acceptance_criteria.when: New activity is verified on backend and broadcast via SSE stream
acceptance_criteria.then: Connected client receives the event and updates live distances and leaderboard standings without manual page refresh (F5)

acceptance_criteria.story: Mantis Material UI as Default System Theme (US-THEME-DEFAULT-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: User loading the OpenRace application without preexisting explicit theme override
acceptance_criteria.when: Page loads and HTML is rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: System renders Mantis Material UI by default (body[data-theme='mantis'], #mantis-sidebar, #mantis-header, #mantis-dashboard-view visible; Sport layout #slim-rail, #openrace-header, #sub-nav-bar, #openrace-dashboard-view hidden) while preserving dynamic switching to Sport Cam

acceptance_criteria.story: Global Race Selector Bar UI Alignment with Mantis Material UI Design System (US-RACE-BAR-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: Tournament overview tab in default Mantis Material UI theme
acceptance_criteria.when: Global Race Selector Bar (#global-race-selector-bar) renders
acceptance_criteria.then: Displays clean Mantis card styling (bg-white, border-[#F0F0F0], text-[#262626]), refined Ant Design select dropdown without harsh orange outline, harmonious SSE live badge, single-line balanced title, and smooth progress bar

acceptance_criteria.story: Top-Level Full-Width Header Row for Race Selector Bar (US-RACE-BAR-02)
acceptance_criteria.given: Tournament overview tab in default Mantis Material UI theme
acceptance_criteria.when: Global Race Selector Bar (#global-race-selector-bar) renders
acceptance_criteria.then: Title 'Bảng Điều Khiển Giải Đấu' and badges are positioned on top in a dedicated full-width header row with bottom border separator, preventing text compression/wrapping, while the dropdown selector and progress bar occupy a clean, spacious row below it
